name: gemsprout
description: Family routines, photo proof, savings, and weekly growth across one home or two

scripts.test: echo "No default test configured. Use: npm run test:e2e"
scripts.test:rules:v2: firebase emulators:exec --config v2/firebase.production.json --project demo-gemsprout-rules --only firestore "node scripts/test-v2-firestore-rules.cjs"
scripts.migration:v2:preview: npm run build:v2 && node v2/scripts/preview-v1-migration.cjs 6.10backup.json migration-preview
scripts.migration:v2:import:full:dry: npm run migration:v2:preview:full && node v2/scripts/import-full-v1-firestore.cjs --project gemsprout-v2-dev --database "(default)"
scripts.migration:v2:import:full:write:dev: npm run migration:v2:preview:full && node v2/scripts/import-full-v1-firestore.cjs --project gemsprout-v2-dev --database "(default)" --write
scripts.migration:v2:import:full:prod:dry: npm run migration:v2:preview:full:prod && node v2/scripts/import-full-v1-firestore.cjs --input all-families-v2-production-migration-preview.json --project gemsprout1 --database "(default)" --allow-production-project
scripts.migration:v2:import:full:dev:production-: npm run migration:v2:preview:full:prod && node v2/scripts/import-full-v1-firestore.cjs --input all-families-v2-production-migration-preview.json --project gemsprout-v2-dev --database "(default)"

npm run migration:v2:preview:full:prod && node v2/scripts/import-full-v1-firestore.cjs --input all-families-v2-production-migration-preview.json --project gemsprout-v2-dev --database "(default)" --write
scripts.migration:v2:import:dry: npm run build:v2 && node v2/scripts/import-v1-migration.cjs --input 6.10backup.json --family-id migration-preview --project gemsprout-v2-dev --database "(default)"
scripts.migration:v2:import:write:dev: npm run build:v2 && node v2/scripts/import-v1-migration.cjs --input 6.10backup.json --family-id migration-preview --project gemsprout-v2-dev --database "(default)" --write
scripts.test:v2: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('v2/dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && npm run build:v2 && node --test "v2/dist/tests/**/*.test.js"
